mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a full moon tonight, but be aware of the elevated air quality index of 55. We will see an overnight low of 62 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is currently running an I Voted sticker design contest featuring artwork from local students across all grade levels. You can view and vote for your favorite designs online through August 7 to help decide which ones will be used in the November election.

There is plenty to do in our city, including trivia happening today at Hop Haus Brewing Company and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market or enjoy pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In terms of our weekly report, on last Sunday a drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's office in locating an individual who had fled a residence in the Town of Springdale.
Today is a great day to stop by for the Georgia Peach flavor of the day, and you can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today between 1:30 PM and 4:15 PM.
